pages.text: Bring a ranged option and watch your footing — the Aether is the aerial T2 dimension, and vertical combat is its whole challenge.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Three major bosses (Slider, Valkyrie Queen, Sun Spirit) each drop Simply Swords uniques. The Aether introduces aerial combat as the primary challenge.$(br2)$(bold)Mechanics:$() Falling damage is doubled in the Aether. No natural regen while airborne. Ranger class is especially effective here.
$(bold)Materials:$() Zanite, Gravitite, and Ambrosium are Aether-native materials. Gravitite armor has a natural levitation effect — useful but costs you ground stability.

$(bold)No guide book.$() The Aether is exploration-driven — the Silver Dungeon, Gold Dungeon, and Obsidian Pinnacle each have discoverable lore. The $(bold)Book of Lore$() found in dungeons provides in-world narrative context.$(br2)$(bold)Next: the Slider in the Bronze Dungeon — the Aether's first boss and your shot at Thunderbrand.$()
